name: What is an ADU and what are the benefits of building one?

mainEntity.name: What is an ADU and what are the benefits of building one?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a secondary housing unit on a single-family residential lot. Benefits include increasing property value, generating rental income, providing housing for family members, or creating a dedicated workspace. ADUs can be detached, attached, or converted from existing structures like garages. They offer flexible living solutions and can help address housing needs without requiring new land development.
acceptedAnswer.description: An ADU is a secondary housing unit on a residential lot, offering benefits like increased property value, rental income, or flexible living space for family.
